title: Concept: security group open to the world
description: A rule that admits 0.0.0.0/0 accepts traffic from every address on the internet, so the exposed port is reachable by anyone who scans it. The range is the defect; whether the service should be public at all is a separate design decision.
applicability: Terraform configuration that declares network security groups.
risk: Unrestricted network exposure of the port; HIGH severity.
